title: feat: accept GET for x402 prepaid keys
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Accept GET as well as POST for bodyless x402 prepaid-key purchases, following Apify AGI’s interface.
- Keep the existing payment, key issuance, and replay handling shared between both methods.
- Document and test both methods, including their 402 challenges and OpenAPI operations.

Follow-up to #16444.

Tests: Enter typecheck; x402-keys integration suite (7 passed).

gist.headline: Two paths to a prepaid key
gist.blurb: GET joins POST at the x402 prepaid-key counter. Both take the same payment path and hand back a key; the HTTP method no longer needs to be a negotiation.
gist.summary: The x402 prepaid-key purchase endpoint accepts bodyless GET alongside POST, with both methods sharing 402 payment challenges, key issuance, and replay handling and appearing in OpenAPI.
gist.impact: Clients using Apify AGI’s GET interface can purchase prepaid keys while retaining the same payment and replay behavior as POST.
gist.visual_concept: Depict GET and POST as two garden paths leading to one small prepaid-key counter, with a 402 payment sign and a key behind it. Polli, wearing a tiny cashier visor, welcomes a CRT monitor robot arriving by the GET path; code-plants and flowers make the shared destination clear.
